clean_target_tier: Tier 1 Actionable (Lead NSCLC Brain Metastasis Colonization Driver & Dual-Compartment Target)
cascade_step: bbb_transit / cns_colonization (Compartment 1: tumor-intrinsic EGFR ectodomain cleavage -> soluble EGFR signaling; Compartment 2: brain-metastatic immune/myeloid aggregate reprogramming)

dual_compartment_bace1_mechanism.summary: Verified GSE223499 snRNA-seq and Zhang et al. 2022 (MOESM6_ESM.xlsx) spatial profiling establish a dual-compartment mechanism for BACE1 in NSCLC brain metastasis, supporting coordinated tumor-intrinsic and myeloid-reprogramming activity for verubecestat (MK-8931).

compartment_1_malignant_tumor_like.compartment: Malignant tumor_like (GSE223499) + TCGA-LUAD primary tumors + Chafe 2025 in vivo CRISPRa (GSE237446)
compartment_1_malignant_tumor_like.chafe_2025_gse237446_crispra: >150x brain-vs-lung enrichment (#1 genome-wide hit, LFC = +7.28 to +7.37)
compartment_1_malignant_tumor_like.mechanism: BACE1 overexpressed on NSCLC cells cleaves the EGFR ectodomain to release a soluble EGFR fragment that drives blood-brain barrier (BBB) extravasation and parenchymal colonization.

compartment_2_myeloid_immune_aggregate.compartment: Brain-metastatic immune_aggregate (GSE223499) + Zhang 2022 TIME-B vs LB peritumoral myeloid cuff (MOESM6_ESM.xlsx)
compartment_2_myeloid_immune_aggregate.mechanism: BACE1 is FDR-significantly upregulated (3.55x, padj = 0.0161) in the brain-metastatic immune/myeloid aggregate, co-localizing with the Zhang 2022 TIME-B vs LB CD163+/MRC1+/C1Q+ M2 myeloid cuff (q = 2.86e-10) where PTPRC+ leukocytes are trapped 3.98x outside the tumor core (q = 3.11e-8). Pharmacological BACE1 inhibition with verubecestat (MK-8931) therefore provides dual tumor-intrinsic (EGFR ectodomain cleavage blockade) and myeloid-reprogramming activity.

1_functional_in_vivo_discovery.citation: Chafe SC et al., Science Translational Medicine 2025 (DOI: 10.1126/scitranslmed.adu2459)
1_functional_in_vivo_discovery.assay: Genome-wide dCas9-VPR in vivo CRISPRa screen in orthotopic NSCLC brain metastasis xenograft models
1_functional_in_vivo_discovery.brain_vs_lung_enrichment: >150-fold enrichment in brain metastases vs primary lung tumors
1_functional_in_vivo_discovery.validated_mechanism: BACE1 over-expressed on NSCLC cells cleaves the EGFR extracellular domain, releasing a soluble EGFR fragment that drives blood-brain barrier (BBB) extravasation and brain parenchymal colonization. Genetic BACE1 KO and pharmacological inhibition with verubecestat (MK-8931) both block NSCLC brain metastasis in vivo.
1_functional_in_vivo_discovery.orthogonality_to_alzheimers: In Alzheimer's disease, BACE1 inhibition targeted physiological neuronal APP cleavage over 18-24 months and failed due to chronic neuronal NRG1/SEZ6 substrate disruption. In NSCLC BrM, BACE1 is aberrantly overexpressed on malignant epithelial cells driving EGFR cleavage and in the brain-metastatic immune/myeloid aggregate (padj = 0.0161), enabling an acute 8-12 week peri-operative/prophylactic interception window.

gse223499_gonzalez_ericsson_2025_snRNAse.cohort: Human NSCLC patient samples: 28 Brain Metastases (BrM) vs 11 Primary Lung Tumors

tumor_like_compartment.forensic_caveat: tumor_like pools CNV+ malignant cells with 151,285 CNV-negative 'Tumor (Not Tumor)' reactive CNS glial/stromal cells; directional upregulation (+1.0688 LFC, p=0.0158, padj=0.0708) is nominal/trending.

confirmed_tumor_cnv_positive_compartment.cohort_subset: 10 BrM vs 11 Primary with >=20 CNV-confirmed aneuploid tumor cells
confirmed_tumor_cnv_positive_compartment.forensic_caveat: Severely underpowered in CNV-confirmed subset (baseMean = 3.84 counts), but preserves positive directional sign (+0.7805 LFC).

immune_aggregate_compartment.significance: FDR-significant (padj = 0.0161; 3.55x upregulation in brain-metastatic myeloid/immune aggregate)
immune_aggregate_compartment.zhang2022_spatial_link: Connects directly to Zhang 2022 TIME-B vs LB peritumoral CD163/MRC1/C1Q M2 myeloid cuff (CD163 6.39x, q=2.86e-10; MRC1 3.23x, q=7.64e-5) and PTPRC 3.98x peritumoral leukocyte trapping (q=3.11e-8).

gse131907_kim_2020_scRNAseq.cohort: Human LUAD scRNA-seq epithelial pseudobulk: 10 BrM vs 11 Primary LUAD
gse131907_kim_2020_scRNAseq.retracted_prior_claim: Prior agent fabricated padj = 0.017 in early tables; actual PyDESeq2 padj is 0.5740 (NS), further confounded by 10-gene size-factor normalization.

tcga_luad_pancancer_atlas.biomarker_high_stratum: Top quartile (z >= 0.52) comprises 128 / 510 patients (25.1%), defining the targetable BACE1-high / EGFR-axis NSCLC patient subpopulation.

retracted_datasets_never_cite: GSE186344 (p = 1.08e-9): RETRACTED — single-arm BrM-only atlas with zero primary lung tumor controls.
GSE200563 (LFC = -0.34, padj = 0.775): RETRACTED FOR BRM — glioma radioresistance dataset, not lung brain metastasis.

3_depmap_safety_and_selectivity.therapeutic_index_interpretation: Unlike NOM1 (mean Chronos = -0.725, 82.5% pan-lethal COMMON_ESSENTIAL), BACE1 is completely non-essential for basal 2D cell viability, proving it acts as a specialized in vivo BBB colonization protease rather than a toxic housekeeping gene.

4_alphafold3_structural_guide_validation.spacer_modality_reconciliation: RECONCILED IN real_guides.json: TCTTCCCATGGCAGGCAATC is explicitly tagged as modality='CRISPRi_dCas9_KRAB_TSS' (AF3-verified TSS-proximal dCas9-KRAB transcriptional repression guide: sgRNA↔Template DNA_B ipTM = 0.418 mean / 0.43 m0, spacer ΔPAE = 6.17 Å, 0 clashes), distinct from coding-exon SpCas9 KO spacers (modality='SpCas9_KO_coding_exon': GCGAGCCGCGAGCTGGATTA / GTGGTGCTGGCTTCCCCATC).

small_molecule_repurposing_candidate.clinical_history: Phase 3 Alzheimer's asset (EPOCH); ~40% human CNS CSF penetration; ~70% BACE1 target inhibition at 12 mg/day.
small_molecule_repurposing_candidate.dual_compartment_activity: Simultaneously inhibits Compartment 1 malignant tumor-cell BACE1 (blocking EGFR ectodomain cleavage and BBB extravasation; GSE223499 tumor_like LFC = +1.0688, p = 0.0158) and Compartment 2 brain-metastatic immune/myeloid aggregate BACE1 (GSE223499 immune_aggregate LFC = +1.8268 [3.55x], p = 0.00224, padj = 0.0161; reprogramming the Zhang 2022 TIME-B vs LB CD163+/MRC1+/C1Q+ M2 cuff [q = 2.86e-10] where PTPRC+ leukocytes are trapped 3.98x [q = 3.11e-8]).
small_molecule_repurposing_candidate.brm_dosing_regimen: 8-12 week peri-operative or high-risk EGFR-mutant LUAD prophylactic window (6-12x shorter than 18-24 month AD trials, avoiding cumulative NRG1/SEZ6 neurotoxicity).
small_molecule_repurposing_candidate.safety_biomarkers: Serial CSF/plasma soluble NRG1 and SEZ6 monitoring.
small_molecule_repurposing_candidate.critical_wet_lab_experiment_required: Measure verubecestat IC50 specifically for BACE1-mediated EGFR ectodomain cleavage in NSCLC cells (currently assumed ~10 nM from APP cleavage, unpublished for EGFR).

nanocarrier_delivery_sink_constraint.discovery_source: Zhang et al. 2022 MOESM6_ESM.xlsx (Sheet TIME-B vs. LB, Rows 30, 47, 55, 74, 75, 81, 84, 93, 147)
nanocarrier_delivery_sink_constraint.lrp1_peritumoral_sink: LRP1 is enriched +1.8066 log2FC (3.50-fold, p=9.92e-9, q=1.48e-6) in peritumoral brain myeloid/microglial stroma (TIME-B) vs BrM tumor core (LB), co-enriched with endogenous ligand APOE (+3.3511 log2FC, 10.20x, q=5.84e-8), CD163 (+2.6753 log2FC, 6.39x, q=2.86e-10), and MRC1 (+1.6930 log2FC, 3.23x, q=7.64e-5).
nanocarrier_delivery_sink_constraint.mmp2_protease_gate: MMP2 is enriched +1.8732 log2FC (3.66-fold, q=7.82e-7) in TIME-B vs LB, whereas MMP9 is absent in TIME-B vs LB and only significant in lung stroma TIME-L vs L (+1.8776 log2FC, 3.68x, q=5.29e-7).
nanocarrier_delivery_sink_constraint.required_nanocarrier_architecture: 3-Stage BTB Delivery Gate: (Stage 1) Low-avidity Angiopep-2 LRP1 BBB shuttle calibrated against 10.20x APOE competition in TIME-B (q=5.84e-8); (Stage 2) MMP2-cleavable PEG stealth corona (3.66x in TIME-B vs LB, q=7.82e-7) to prevent premature uptake by the 3.50x LRP1+ (q=1.48e-6) CD163+ MRC1+ peritumoral myeloid sink; (Stage 3) Secondary tumor-cell receptor lock (EGFR/HER2/CEACAM5) for selective internalization into LB tumor cells.
